Workspace-wide TypeScript + ESLint enforcement
hyperedges.description: Combined base TypeScript config (strict, isolatedModules) with ESLint flat config using typescript-eslint; creates unified type safety and linting across apps/admin, apps/api, apps/frontend

hyperedges.label: Bundler-driven transpilation strategy
hyperedges.description: ESNext modules + Bundler resolution + isolatedModules allows independent transpilation per app (Vite/esbuild/Astro) while maintaining consistent type checking

hyperedges.label: i18n Multi-Phase Implementation
hyperedges.description: Five coordinated phases: global registry (Phase 1), per-tenant subset (Phase 2), content translations with design correction (Phase 3/4), and opt-in switches (Phase 5 + follow-ups)

hyperedges.label: Auth Hardening Suite
hyperedges.description: Integrated authentication security: rate limiting (tenant + login), Entra SSO with CSRF protection, MFA enrollment, session cookies + CSRF tokens

hyperedges.label: Security validation boundary
hyperedges.description: Layout validation enforces tight allowlist for CSS/HTML interpolation to prevent stored injection attacks

hyperedges.label: Designer Canvas & Rendering System
hyperedges.description: Unified page building with multiple surfaces (Blocks canvas, Live Edit iframe, device preview, history/revisions) sharing same block model

hyperedges.label: Cross-app render consistency pattern
hyperedges.description: Unifies style computation between admin canvas preview and published site rendering via shared element-render package

nodes.label: NOTE: SWITCHER_POSITIONS/SWITCHER_STYLES stay defined in index.ts (unused
nodes.norm_label: note: switcher_positions/switcher_styles stay defined in index.ts (unused

nodes.label: i18n Phase 3/4: Content Translations (Corrected Design)
nodes.contributor: One row per post/page, not one per language. language column = base row's language. translations jsonb = every OTHER language keyed by code. For posts: {title, excerpt, body}. For pages: {overrides} (sparse per-path prop bag).

nodes.label: i18n Phase 3/4: Rejected First Design
nodes.contributor: Original design spawned separate post/page per language (own slug/id), visibly multiplied content list. Live feedback: 'taknak mcm ni, dia jd duplicate post... tapi kat post editor boleh switch'. Corrected to in-editor pill switcher on single row.

nodes.label: Design: Language Code Immutable
nodes.contributor: Phase 2-3 will reference code values directly. Letting it change would silently break those references. Not offered in UI, validated on write.

nodes.label: i18n Phase 1: Global Language Registry
nodes.contributor: languages table (control-plane): superadmin-curated master list. Immutable code (prevents breaking per-language references). guardLastEnabled prevents zero enabled languages.

nodes.label: i18n Phase 2: Per-Tenant Language Subset
nodes.contributor: tenant_languages (control-plane): per-tenant enabled_codes. Absence means inherit all globally-enabled languages. Re-resolved live on each read, disabling globally instantly drops from all tenants.

nodes.label: i18n Phase 5 Follow-up: Default Language
nodes.contributor: tenant_languages.defaultLanguage (nullable). New post/page language defaults to this. Picked from currently-selected subset (no default outside tenant's offered languages). Silently cleared if deselected in same edit.

nodes.label: i18n Phase 5: WPML-style Opt-in Switch
nodes.contributor: tenant_languages.multilangEnabled (site-wide) + posts/pages.multilangEnabled (per-row). Pill switcher only renders when BOTH true. Language-subset checkboxes disabled while site switch off.

nodes.label: Designer.tsx admin canvas
nodes.rationale: Admin UI that produces element field definitions stored in pages.layout as free-text prop bags, validated server-side by element-schema validators.

nodes.label: Frontend site renderer
nodes.rationale: Astro SSR renderer that consumes pages.layout via SliderBlock.astro, using element-render utilities to compute CSS declarations for published pages.

nodes.label: CSS-injection via semicolon/paren/brace escaping
nodes.rationale: Unvalidated CSS URL values concatenated into raw url(...) rules can break out and inject arbitrary CSS affecting every tenant visitor. Applies to bgImage/imageUrl fields.

nodes.label: Cross-app render-value computation
nodes.rationale: Both apps/admin and apps/frontend previously hand-duplicated style computation logic, causing recurring 'Live Edit doesn't match Preview/Published' bugs. This shared utility returns plain camelCase declaration maps serialization-agnostic for both React and Astro SSR usage.

nodes.label: Element layout validation schema
nodes.rationale: Validates every prop value before database write to prevent CSS-injection and XSS vectors. Mirrors Designer.tsx field definitions to keep admin UI and API validation in lockstep. Lives in separate package as pure logic with no framework dependencies.

nodes.label: Free-positioned slider element positioning
nodes.rationale: Slide-nested elements use position:absolute with x/y percentages, width/height CSS lengths, z-index stacking, and CSS rotate property for composition with entrance animations.

nodes.label: Stored XSS via scheme-less href/src/url
nodes.rationale: Unvalidated scheme values (javascript:/data:) in href/src/url attributes enable arbitrary code execution. Mitigated by isSafeUrl scheme allowlist.

nodes.label: Security: Media Upload Extension Fix
nodes.contributor: Extension derived from server-controlled MEDIA_EXT_BY_MIME map, never client filename. Prevents storing HTML as .html (stored-XSS → session hijack). ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES folded into same map (single source of truth).

nodes.label: Posts Category: Managed Taxonomy
nodes.contributor: Real FK categoryId into categories table (name + slug, both unique). ON DELETE RESTRICT — Postgres refuses delete if posts reference it. Tags stay freeform text[], no managed table.

nodes.label: Design: Tags Freeform, Categories Managed
nodes.contributor: Tags stay text[] (no managed table — nobody asked for managed tag UI). Categories get real FK (managed, renameable, enforced by Postgres). Simpler than both being managed.

nodes.label: Posts Table: Body HTML Sanitization
nodes.contributor: body is sanitized HTML from BlockNote editor. sanitizePostBodyHtml called in postsBeforeChange hook. XSS trust boundary enforced at write-time.

nodes.label: Posts Revisions: History Snapshots
nodes.contributor: post_revisions snapshots on explicit publish/private status change, not every edit. Admin History panel lists them. Restore copies snapshot back as new draft (never auto-republishes).

nodes.label: Design: Category Name Snapshot in Post Revision
nodes.contributor: post_revisions.category is plain denormalized text, not FK back to categories. Revision should show whatever category name post had at that moment, not break if category later renamed/deleted.
nodes.norm_label: design: category name snapshot in post revision

nodes.label: Auth: Microsoft Entra ID SSO
nodes.contributor: Hand-rolled OIDC Authorization Code flow. Never auto-provisions (users table is real ~40-account allowlist against ~1000 Entra staff). Three modes: password-only, both, Entra-only. Superadmin exempt from Entra-only (break-glass).

nodes.label: Auth: Entra Login CSRF Fix
nodes.contributor: Random nonce bound to both ucms_entra_state HttpOnly cookie (10min TTL) and signed state's entraNonce claim. /entra/callback requires timing-safe nonce match, clears cookie (one-time use). Callback redirects bare (only entraError on query string).

nodes.label: Auth: Session Cookie + CSRF Migration
nodes.contributor: Session moved from localStorage bearer token to httpOnly cookie. Every mutating request requires x-csrf-token header (synchronizer-token-in-session pattern). Impersonation cookie overwrite + POST /api/portal/exit-impersonation to restore superadmin.

nodes.label: Design: Never Auto-Provision from Entra
nodes.contributor: USIM has ~1000 Entra staff but only ~40 CMS accounts. users table is the real allowlist. Entra proves identity, users row grants access. Prevents unauthorized account creation.

nodes.label: Collections: Code-First System
nodes.contributor: CollectionConfig (slug, access functions, beforeChange/afterChange hooks) registered via registerPublicCollectionRoutes/registerProtectedCollectionRoutes. Generic CRUD routes auto-mounted at /api/:collectionSlug.

nodes.label: Design: RLS as Defense-in-Depth
nodes.contributor: On top of database-per-tenant isolation. Even if generic-crud handler forgets auth check, Postgres refuses writes unless connection set app.authenticated session var. FORCE prevents superuser bypass.

nodes.label: Collections: Generic Query Filters
nodes.contributor: buildListFilters: exact-match on any column, ?tag= array-contains, ?from=/?to= range on publishedAt, ?search= ILIKE on title. Capped at 10 rows per table. total count only when ?limit= sent.

nodes.label: Blue-green zero-downtime deployment
nodes.rationale: Deployment automation with shared secret validation, health checks, smoke test verification before promotion, and multi-replica service orchestration.

nodes.label: Multi-tenant database setup
nodes.rationale: Control-plane database with per-tenant databases auto-provisioned on first request via tenant-pool.ts. App role authentication via password rotation pattern with pgbouncer configuration.

nodes.label: Auth: Per-Tenant Request Budget
nodes.contributor: isTenantRateLimited checks 1200 requests per 60s per tenantHost. Checked before DB connection acquired. Redis-backed when REDIS_URL set, per-process Map fallback. Protects other tenants from one tenant's spike.

nodes.label: Auth: Login Rate Limiting
nodes.contributor: login_attempts table (control-plane): 5 failed attempts per email OR per IP within 15min trips 429. Checked BEFORE password lookup (no timing oracle). Pruned lazily on write (24h retention).

nodes.label: Auth: MFA (TOTP) Implementation
nodes.contributor: node:crypto only, RFC 6238 6-digit/30-second. generateTotpSecret/verifyTotpCode/totpAuthUri. Verified against official RFC 6238 Appendix B test vector in auth.test.ts.

nodes.label: Auth: Mandatory MFA Enrollment
nodes.contributor: platformSettings.mfaRequired forces non-superadmin accounts through enrollment at login. Returns {mfaSetupRequired, pendingToken, secret, otpauthUri}. Superadmin exempt (break-glass). /api/auth/totp-setup-verify exchanges for real session.

nodes.label: Multi-tenancy: Database-per-Tenant Architecture
nodes.contributor: DATABASE_URL holds control plane only (tenants/users/roles/site_theme/shared_content/theme_presets/languages registry). Tenant content (pages/posts/categories/etc) lives in separate DB per tenant. Isolation real, not filter-based.

nodes.label: Control Plane Database
nodes.contributor: Holds registry only: tenants, users, roles, site_theme, shared_content, theme_presets, languages, tenant_languages, login_attempts, audit_log, platform_settings. Tenant content never stored here.

nodes.label: Device Preview Modal
nodes.contributor: Real device dimensions (iPhone 14/15 393x852, iPad Air 820x1180, Desktop 1440x900). Rotate control, scale-to-fit, no in-frame scrollbar via touch-drag script on frontend.

nodes.label: Elementor-style Drag-Slider Numeric Fields
nodes.contributor: New FieldKind 'drag-number': range input synced with number box. Replaces stepper for lineHeight/letterSpacing/fontSize/wordSpacing on typography fields.

nodes.label: Live Edit = Preview, Exact
nodes.contributor: Both render through DeviceViewport with true device sizes, not aspect-ratio approximations. Real iframe mounts in Designer, reloads after every edit. Typing inside iframe skips reload until selection moves away.

nodes.label: First Designer E2E Smoke Test
nodes.contributor: Playwright e2e test: seed disposable tenant+superadmin, drive UI to add section+heading, Save draft, reload, assert persistence. Manual run only (needs live API), not build-time gated.

nodes.label: Database: Missing FK Indexes
nodes.contributor: Added to posts.categoryId, pages.headerId/footerId, postRevisions.postId, pageRevisions.pageId, media.folderId (tenant DBs) and users.roleId, themePresets.ownerUserId (control-plane). Prevents sequential scans on FK checks/lookups.

nodes.label: Media: Alt Text Required Rule
nodes.contributor: isDecorative boolean exempts image from alt-text-required rule. Admin MediaManager disables/requires alt field accordingly. Sprint 4 UX audit.

nodes.label: Security: Tenant Pool Idle Eviction
nodes.contributor: tenantPools evicted after 30min idle (sweep every 5min). Closes in-process connection pools, next request re-provisions. Prevents 500 idle-but-open connections per 100 tenants.

nodes.label: Security: Tenant Host Check Denial
nodes.contributor: Changed from allowlist (role === 'webmaster') to denylist (role !== 'superadmin'). Paired with CHECK (role IN (...)) constraint on public.users.role.

nodes.label: Design: Backup/Restore Includes Site Chrome
nodes.contributor: pages.headerId/footerId are real FKs into site_chrome. Dump must include siteChrome, insert order: site_chrome before pages (FK dependency). Was missing, caused 400 on promote clone to new tenant.

nodes.label: Design: Symbols Live-Linked, Templates One-Shot
nodes.contributor: design_templates: copy on insertion, edited independently after. symbols: store symbolId, resolve node at render time. Different use cases: templates for one-time reuse, symbols for shared components.

nodes.label: Fastify Backend Framework
nodes.contributor: Fast HTTP server, built-in JSON schema validation, plugin/encapsulation system suitable for tenant scoping (public vs protected).

nodes.label: React Admin UI
nodes.contributor: React 18, Vite bundler, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI primitives + shadcn conventions. Real routing (react-router-dom BrowserRouter, not useState conditional mount).

nodes.label: Designer Page Builder Canvas
nodes.contributor: Drag-drop block canvas with Live Edit (real frontend in iframe), Inspector panel, element palette. Primary editing surface.

nodes.label: Pages Table: Layout JSONB
nodes.contributor: Dynamic block layout stored as JSONB array. Each block has type + props. Designer is CRUD interface for this column. RLS enforces authenticated-only writes.

nodes.label: Recursive Container Element
nodes.contributor: ElType container for nestable flex boxes. V1 scope: curated child type subset, Inspector-button management only, no canvas drag/resize chrome, no per-language override.

nodes.label: Selection Path Mutation De-hardcoding
nodes.contributor: Extracted generic depth-agnostic path primitives (childrenOf, locate, getNode, removeAt, insertAt, moveWithin). Replaces ~40 hand-written [b,r,c,e] indexing chains. Zero external signature changes.

nodes.label: Site Chrome: Header/Footer Designer
nodes.contributor: Header/footer designs built with same Designer canvas as pages. kind (header/footer), layout/translations (same as pages), settings (sticky, mobileNav). Exactly one isDefault per kind. Pages override via headerId/footerId or hideHeader/hideFooter.

nodes.label: Frontend: Per-Tenant Maintenance Mode
nodes.contributor: Middleware checks GET /api/tenant-status. Returns maintenance HTML (503) if tenants.maintenanceMode is true. Fails open on apps/api hiccup.

nodes.label: Design: Pages Have No Private Status
nodes.contributor: Posts have draft/published/private. Pages only have draft/published. RLS same branch for both unpublished states. Single-branch revision snapshot (no dual branch like posts).
nodes.norm_label: design: pages have no private status

nodes.label: Row Flex Container
nodes.contributor: Row gained layoutMode flex/grid plus flexDirection/justifyContent/alignItems/flexWrap. Per-breakpoint column-span overrides drive grid-template-columns. Flip between modes preserves relative widths via flex-grow.

nodes.label: Menus: Nested Navigation Tree
nodes.contributor: Single items jsonb column holds full nested tree. Top-level items, each with optional children (simple dropdown) or megaMenu (multi-column). Menu element in Designer only holds menuId + render options (layout, dropdownTrigger, megaMenuWidth).

nodes.label: Pages Settings: Designer Defaults
nodes.contributor: gap (default column gap for rows), contentWidth (contained/full), paddingX (section padding), theme (optional Theme Preset snapshot). Copied at pick-time, not live-linked.

nodes.label: Frontend: HTML Edge Cache (Redis)
nodes.contributor: lib/html-cache.ts checks right after maintenance gate, written before return. Skipped for preview/theme-preview/Live-Edit tokens or maintenance-bypass cookie.

nodes.label: Frontend: Astro 7 SSR
nodes.contributor: output: server with @astrojs/node middleware mode. server.mjs owns http.Server for graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT close. No static pre-build (tenant identity from Host header at runtime).

nodes.label: Pages Revisions: History Snapshots
nodes.contributor: page_revisions snapshots layout/settings/bannerImageUrl/status/publishedAt on publish only (no private status). Designer header History button opens modal with lazy-loaded revisions. Restore writes directly to page object and canvas state.

nodes.label: Live Edit Bridge
nodes.contributor: postMessage bridge to BaseLayout.astro for click-to-select and inline editing on the real published page inside iframe. Primary editing surface, Blocks mode is layout guide only.

nodes.label: Frontend: Content Security Policy
nodes.contributor: script-src/style-src keep unsafe-inline (inline styles everywhere). Blocks external script loading (no external host in script-src) + exfiltration (connect-src self). img-src/frame-src open to https. frame-ancestors scoped to ADMIN_ORIGIN when set.

nodes.label: Slider Canvas Canva-style Controls
nodes.contributor: 8 resize handles on free-positioned slide children, rotate + move toolbar, magenta center/edge smart guides, floating action toolbar (Edit/Lock/Duplicate/Delete/Align).

nodes.label: ESLint ignore patterns (dist, node_modules, .astro)
nodes.rationale: Standard workspace exclusions; .astro skipped intentionally pending astro plugin integration

nodes.label: apps/api and apps/frontend .ts file linting
nodes.rationale: Plain TypeScript (no React) in api; only lib/api.ts in frontend gets linted; no React hooks plugin for these

nodes.label: Deferred .astro linting support
nodes.rationale: Requires eslint-plugin-astro + custom parser; postponed until frontend component logic grows sufficiently to justify dependency; current .astro files use no linting

nodes.label: ESLint Flat Config (v9+)
nodes.rationale: Modern ESLint configuration format using export default with tseslint.config(); replaces .eslintrc files for cleaner, more explicit configuration

nodes.label: apps/admin TypeScript/TSX linting scope
nodes.rationale: React hooks plugin applied only to admin app where React components live

nodes.label: TypeScript isolatedModules enabled
nodes.rationale: Ensures each file can be transpiled independently; required for esbuild (api) and Vite (admin) transpilation

nodes.label: TypeScript module: ESNext
nodes.rationale: Allows modern module syntax; actual transpilation deferred to bundlers (Vite for admin, esbuild for api, Astro for frontend)

nodes.label: TypeScript moduleResolution: Bundler
nodes.rationale: Modern Node resolution using export conditions and package.json exports field; correct for monorepo with bundler-driven build

nodes.label: TypeScript resolveJsonModule enabled
nodes.rationale: Allows importing .json files as modules; used for package metadata and configuration

nodes.label: TypeScript strict mode enabled
nodes.rationale: Enables all strict type checking flags for maximum type safety across workspace

nodes.label: Rationale: translations jsonb single-row design (rejected one-row-per-language)
nodes.norm_label: rationale: translations jsonb single-row design (rejected one-row-per-language)

nodes.label: Dependabot Config (grouped updates, Postgres major ignore)
nodes.norm_label: dependabot config (grouped updates, postgres major ignore)

nodes.label: Known gaps (no HA/replication, no load-test baseline, no auto-rollback)
nodes.norm_label: known gaps (no ha/replication, no load-test baseline, no auto-rollback)

nodes.label: Pages i18n Rework — Sparse Style Overrides
nodes.norm_label: pages i18n rework — sparse style overrides

nodes.norm_label: httponly cookie session + csrf token header
